entries.07f0bf2697636c72: A reportable segment, the largest in the group, that sells FA equipment and industrial machinery, including programmable controllers, inverters, AC servos, various motors, power distribution and control equipment, industrial robots, electrical discharge machines, laser processing machines, connectors, embedded devices, industrial PCs, touch-panel monitors and others.
entries.13ad5f5550042773: A reportable segment, the largest in the group, that sells FA equipment and industrial machinery, including programmable controllers, inverters, AC servos, various motors, power distribution and control equipment, industrial robots, electrical discharge machines, laser processing machines, connectors, embedded devices, industrial PCs, touch-panel monitors and others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥109,865 million. As an agency and special distributor of Mitsubishi Electric, it handles FA products and also focuses on its system solutions business. In addition to the company, consolidated subsidiaries such as Kendenkōgyō Co., Ltd., Daidensha Co., Ltd. and Takagi Konekuto Co., Ltd. handle sales, and overseas sales subsidiaries in Taiwan, Shanghai, Bangkok, Malaysia, India and others handle sales overseas.
entries.14e721b30d6e7e08: A technology trading company that purchases FA equipment, semiconductors and electronic devices, and facility equipment from manufacturers such as Mitsubishi Electric and Renesas Electronics, and sells them together with technical support to customers such as manufacturers.
entries.1d002ffd9e6d205c: A reportable segment that sells semiconductors, including microcontrollers, ASICs, power modules, memory, analog ICs and logic ICs, and electronic devices, including memory cards, contact image sensors and liquid crystal displays and others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥89,156 million. It handles semiconductors under a distribution agreement with Renesas Electronics. In addition to the company, consolidated subsidiaries such as Tachibana Device Component Co., Ltd. and Tachibana Denshi Solutions Co., Ltd. handle development, design, manufacturing, sales and maintenance of semiconductors and electronic device products, and overseas sales subsidiaries in Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Shanghai, Bangkok, Malaysia and India handle overseas sales.
